raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 주말 식물 마켓을 홍보해줘. SNS에 올릴 16:9 가로 포스터 다섯 장이 필요해. 각각 전체 스타일과 레이아웃이 달랐으면 좋겠어. 식물을 고르고 집에서 돌보는 즐거움이 느껴지도록 만들고, 긴 설명과 방문 안내가 자연스럽게 읽히게 해줘. 큰 고딕 제목과 정보 블록에 작은 이미지나 질감을 붙이는 단색 템플릿은 제외해줘. 로고·QR·새 문구 없이 다음 문구를 각 한 번씩 정확히 넣어줘.

집 안의 작은 숲
LEAVES & LIVING
초록을 고르고, 일상을 가꿉니다.
작은 화분부터 오래 키운 나무까지 만납니다. 재배자의 이야기를 듣고, 우리 집의 빛과 생활에 맞는 식물을 골라보세요.
성수 주말 식물 마켓
2027.06.12–06.13
토·일 11:00–19:00
성수 온실마당
입장 무료 · 분갈이 시연
식물 구매 시 관리 안내 제공
편하게 들러 천천히 둘러보세요.

procedure.method: Fresh independent critic turn; no spawn, resume or fork and no peer/producer/planner records read. First-read copy was then recorded independently from those displayed pixels, preserving soft line breaks and meaningful word spaces. No crops, replacements, image edits or OCR were used. Header checks establish all views are RGB PNG without transparency: native 1672x941, usage 720x405 and thumbnail 320x180. For landscape 16:9 the native height deviation is abs(941-1672*9/16)=0.5px, qualifying under the declared nearest-integer-single-edge policy, not mathematically exact; use/thumbnail dimensions preserve aspect within integer raster rounding. Runtime session identity is unavailable here and remains null. Actual semantic viewing is this critic's attestation, not a claimed helper-generated open or invented serialized event.

emotion_control.location: supporting hands across three photographs

ai_slop.location: three plant/hand photographs and panel joins

content_form.observation: Different plant sizes and window light relate to living with houseplants, but this is a familiar decorated interior with no visible selection, repotting or caring interaction. hierarchy.location: large upper-left invitation, paragraph, under-table details and lower title
hierarchy.observation: The invitation dominates before the topic and event; the long paragraph takes another large tier, with practical details beneath the table and title in a separate shelf opening. The reader can find everything, but the brand/event, description and attendance route feel segmented.

hierarchy.location: top invitation and lower-center title
hierarchy.observation: The invitation and tall tree remain strong, while the lower title is small and distant from the event name. The furniture creates multiple compartments rather than one strong announcement route.

typography.observation: Dark Hangul on light wall areas is readable at 720 width, with clear soft paragraph wrapping, intact date/hours/venue row and unbroken URL. The lower title and English line also remain legible.

Date and hours contain uncertain horizontal range-mark glyphs. The two short vertical strokes outside the copy entries function visibly as row dividers; they are recorded as layout marks, with no inferred extra wording. Exact range punctuation remains NA.

space.location: lower-left wall under table and lower-center shelf opening
space.observation: A broad blank lower-left wall remains after the information rows, while the title is compressed into a different shelf opening. The table legs and second shelf carve up the frame more strongly than the copy relationships justify.

space.location: center/right plant and furniture boundaries
space.observation: The tall right tree and centered tabletop plant balance each other, but the tabletop, under-table rows and lower shelf create stacked horizontal interruptions. The layout is functional but not fully resolved.

image_material.location: leaf drawing, terracotta pots, window and furniture
image_material.observation: Outlined leaves, textured pots and consistent blue-green wood form a coherent illustration. Plants visibly sit on their supports, and the light wedge links window and wall.

emotion_control.location: sunlit window, varied houseplants and invitation
emotion_control.observation: Gentle daylight, approachable illustrated pots and the prominent invitation communicate an unhurried domestic welcome. The emotional voice is consistent even where content specificity and spacing remain weak.

ai_slop.location: plant stems/pots and furniture joins
ai_slop.observation: Leaf clusters connect to stems, pots sit on table/shelf/floor, and the window belongs to the same interior. No unrelated ornament, random badge, logo, QR or watermark appears. The awkward information compartments are retained under hierarchy/space rather than attributed to an invisible production process.

evidence.location: large left gardener and upper-right paragraph
evidence.observation: A single full-bleed painterly human action makes the paragraph the opening and title the lower-left signature. M4 shares repotting content but splits it into photographic stages and opens with the date; their editing, type roles and routes differ.

evidence.location: alternating cream copy and monochrome photo panels

evidence.location: table, window and blue-green shelf with lower title

Its weaker hierarchy/space remains a low finding rather than being erased by diversity.

ai_slop.location: full scene, shadows and plant structures

procedure.method: Independent fresh craft review with no spawning, resuming, forking or peer/producer records. Read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before viewing and did not follow their unlisted embedded paths. The packet supplies no source assets or protected-layout manifests, so those receipt arrays are explicitly empty and there were zero source image opens. Used tools.view_image with detail original and emitted each exact image at original detail, sequentially M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same order. All fifteen images were actually visible before the first poster-copy reading, judgment or score. Transcribed the first raw readings from these rendered pixels in packet copy order, preserving soft line breaks and meaningful word spaces. After retaining all first readings, reopened only M2's exact pinned native once for the ambiguous date/hours range marks; both first readings and unresolved revisit readings remain retained. evidence.location: wide left photograph and tall right photograph

evidence.location: wide left photograph and tall right photograph

content_form.location: hand-held pot and domestic rubber-plant photograph
content_form.observation: The two subjects connect the small-pot-to-grown-tree explanation to a tangible choice and a place in the home; both carry information rather than serving as tiny ornaments.

hierarchy.location: left header through explanation and lower event block

typography.location: Korean title, explanatory paragraph and bottom information
typography.observation: Serif display lettering is differentiated from the sans-serif explanation and bold slogan/market name. All twelve first readings are legible; the three paragraph lines retain meaningful spaces and punctuation, and the URL remains continuous.
The short middle line ends at a sentence clause rather than breaking a word; its soft wrap is separate from the copy comparison.

space.location: bottom information band
space.observation: The venue hangs between the hours column and the support group, while the support group starts noticeably left of the tall photograph's left edge. Its URL sits much closer to the bottom edge than the header and photographs sit to their edges; the lower grid feels assembled rather than fully reconciled.

image_material.location: supporting hand, pot rim and rubber-plant leaves
image_material.observation: The pot rests convincingly on the palm, the leaf surfaces and veins stay coherent, and warm light unifies the domestic photograph. The two crops give readable scale contrast without contradictory visible construction.

emotion_control.location: offering hand and warm interior
emotion_control.observation: The gently supported pot makes choosing feel approachable, and the sunlit chair/large plant gives a calm, specific sense of living with plants. The effect supports the invitation rather than relying on unrelated decoration.

ai_slop.location: plant silhouettes, supporting hand and domestic chair
ai_slop.observation: No definite fused fingers, impossible pot contact, arbitrary badges, printed artifacts or meaningless ornaments are visible. The photographs are conventional, but their subjects and local details remain coherent with the copy.

residuals: The lower information band has weaker column alignment and a tighter bottom margin than the upper image/header structure; space remains 3.
The photo pairing is clear and useful but does not show an actual care operation; care is communicated through domestic placement and the printed guidance rather than an unseen action.

procedure.method: Fresh independent portfolio review, without spawning, forking or resuming, and without reading peer reviews or unlisted embedded records.
